module origen_144900(
    input [99:0] a,
    input [99:0] b,
    input cin,
    input fa_a,
    input fa_b,
    input fa_cin,
    output [99:0] final_sum,
    output cout
);

    wire [99:0] adder_sum;
    wire adder_cout;
    wire fa_sum, fa_cout;

    // 100-bit Carry-Lookahead Adder
    carry_lookahead_adder cla(
        .a(a),
        .b(b),
        .cin(cin),
        .sum(adder_sum),
        .cout(adder_cout)
    );

    // Full Adder using transmission gates and inverters
    full_adder_tg fa(
        .a(fa_a),
        .b(fa_b),
        .cin(fa_cin),
        .sum(fa_sum),
        .cout(fa_cout)
    );

    // Combine results
    final_output_module fom(
        .adder_sum(adder_sum),
        .fa_sum(fa_sum),
        .final_sum(final_sum)
    );

    assign cout = adder_cout;

endmodule

module carry_lookahead_adder(
    input [99:0] a,
    input [99:0] b,
    input cin,
    output [99:0] sum,
    output cout
);

    wire [99:0] g, p;
    wire [100:0] c;

    assign c[0] = cin;

    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 100; i = i + 1) begin : cla_logic
            assign g[i] = a[i] & b[i];
            assign p[i] = a[i] | b[i];
            assign c[i+1] = g[i] | (p[i] & c[i]);
            assign sum[i] = a[i] ^ b[i] ^ c[i];
        end
    endgenerate

    assign cout = c[100];

endmodule

module full_adder_tg(
    input a,
    input b,
    input cin,
    output sum,
    output cout
);

    wire w1, w2, w3, w4;
    wire not_a, not_b, not_cin;

    // Inverters
    assign not_a = ~a;
    assign not_b = ~b;
    assign not_cin = ~cin;

    // Transmission gates for sum
    assign w1 = (a & b & cin) | (not_a & not_b & cin) | (not_a & b & not_cin) | (a & not_b & not_cin);
    assign w2 = (not_a & not_b & not_cin) | (a & b & not_cin) | (a & not_b & cin) | (not_a & b & cin);
    assign sum = w1 | w2;

    // Transmission gates for carry-out
    assign w3 = (a & b) | (b & cin);
    assign w4 = (a & cin);
    assign cout = w3 | w4;

endmodule

module final_output_module(
    input [99:0] adder_sum,
    input fa_sum,
    output [99:0] final_sum
);

    assign final_sum = {adder_sum[99:1], fa_sum};

endmodule
